listing_media_hosted_complete.name: listing_media_hosted_complete
listing_media_hosted_complete.value:
("media_key" IS NULL AND "sha256" IS NULL
    AND "content_type" IS NULL AND "bytes" IS NULL
    AND "width" IS NULL AND "height" IS NULL)
    OR ("media_key" IS NOT NULL AND "sha256" IS NOT NULL
    AND "content_type" IS NOT NULL AND "bytes" IS NOT NULL
    AND "width" IS NOT NULL AND "height" IS NOT NULL
    AND (substr("media_key", 1, 22) = 'best.serp.co/listings/')
    AND instr("media_key", '/' || "kind" || '/') > 0
    AND length("sha256") = 64
    AND "content_type" IN ('image/avif', 'image/gif', 'image/x-icon', 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp')
    AND "bytes" BETWEEN 1 AND 5242880
    AND "width" BETWEEN 1 AND 16384
    AND "height" BETWEEN 1 AND 16384)

listing_submissions_draft_unpaid.name: listing_submissions_draft_unpaid
listing_submissions_draft_unpaid.value: "listing_submissions"."status" != 'draft' OR ("listing_submissions"."paid_at" IS NULL AND "listing_submissions"."listing_id" IS NULL)

listing_submissions_payment_matches_plan.name: listing_submissions_payment_matches_plan
listing_submissions_payment_matches_plan.value: "listing_submissions"."paid_at" IS NULL OR "listing_submissions"."plan" = 'paid' OR "listing_submissions"."refunded_at" IS NOT NULL

listing_submissions_refund_after_payment.name: listing_submissions_refund_after_payment
listing_submissions_refund_after_payment.value: "listing_submissions"."refunded_at" IS NULL OR "listing_submissions"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL

listing_submissions_live_review_paid.name: listing_submissions_live_review_paid
listing_submissions_live_review_paid.value: "listing_submissions"."status" != 'paid_pending_review' OR ("listing_submissions"."listing_id" IS NOT NULL AND "listing_submissions"."plan" = 'paid' AND "listing_submissions"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL AND "listing_submissions"."refunded_at" IS NULL AND "listing_submissions"."published_checksum" IS NOT NULL)

listing_submissions_draft_native.name: listing_submissions_draft_native
listing_submissions_draft_native.value: "listing_submissions"."status" != 'draft' OR ("listing_submissions"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "listing_submissions"."block_key" IS NOT NULL)

listing_submissions_block_scope.name: listing_submissions_block_scope
listing_submissions_block_scope.value: ("listing_submissions"."block_key" IS NULL) = ("listing_submissions"."block_covers_subdomains" IS NULL) AND ("listing_submissions"."block_covers_subdomains" IS NOT 0 OR "listing_submissions"."block_key" = "listing_submissions"."slug")

listing_submissions_withdrawn_unpaid.name: listing_submissions_withdrawn_unpaid
listing_submissions_withdrawn_unpaid.value: "listing_submissions"."status" != 'withdrawn' OR "listing_submissions"."paid_at" IS NULL OR "listing_submissions"."refunded_at" IS NOT NULL

listing_submissions_no_refund_when_prohi.name: listing_submissions_no_refund_when_prohibited
listing_submissions_no_refund_when_prohi.value: "listing_submissions"."refunded_at" IS NULL OR "listing_submissions"."rejection_category" IS NULL OR "listing_submissions"."rejection_category" != 'prohibited'

media_ingestions_one_target.name: media_ingestions_one_target
media_ingestions_one_target.value: ("media_ingestions"."listing_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("media_ingestions"."submission_id" IS NOT NULL) + ("media_ingestions"."revision_id" IS NOT NULL) = 1

media_ingestions_hosted_complete.name: media_ingestions_hosted_complete
media_ingestions_hosted_complete.value:
("media_key" IS NULL AND "sha256" IS NULL
    AND "content_type" IS NULL AND "bytes" IS NULL
    AND "width" IS NULL AND "height" IS NULL)
    OR ("media_key" IS NOT NULL AND "sha256" IS NOT NULL
    AND "content_type" IS NOT NULL AND "bytes" IS NOT NULL
    AND "width" IS NOT NULL AND "height" IS NOT NULL
    AND (substr("media_key", 1, 22) = 'best.serp.co/listings/' OR substr("media_key", 1, 25) = 'best.serp.co/submissions/' OR substr("media_key", 1, 23) = 'best.serp.co/revisions/')
    AND instr("media_key", '/' || "kind" || '/') > 0
    AND length("sha256") = 64
    AND "content_type" IN ('image/avif', 'image/gif', 'image/x-icon', 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp')
    AND "bytes" BETWEEN 1 AND 5242880
    AND "width" BETWEEN 1 AND 16384
    AND "height" BETWEEN 1 AND 16384)

media_ingestions_copy_from_pending.name: media_ingestions_copy_from_pending
media_ingestions_copy_from_pending.value: "media_ingestions"."copy_from_key" IS NULL OR ("media_ingestions"."listing_id" IS NOT NULL AND (substr("copy_from_key", 1, 25) = 'best.serp.co/submissions/' OR substr("copy_from_key", 1, 23) = 'best.serp.co/revisions/'))

orders_target_matches_purpose.name: orders_target_matches_purpose
orders_target_matches_purpose.value:
("orders"."purpose" = 'claim' AND "orders"."kind" = 'paid_claim'
        AND "orders"."claim_id" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."listing_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "orders"."target_key" = 'claim:' || "orders"."claim_id")
      OR ("orders"."purpose" = 'submission' AND "orders"."kind" = 'paid_listing'
        AND "orders"."submission_id" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."claim_id" IS NULL
        AND "orders"."target_key" = 'submission:' || "orders"."submission_id")
      OR ("orders"."purpose" IN ('upgrade', 'relist') AND "orders"."kind" = 'paid_listing'
        AND "orders"."submission_id" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."listing_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "orders"."claim_id" IS NULL AND "orders"."target_key" = 'listing:' || "orders"."listing_id")

orders_paid_recorded.name: orders_paid_recorded
orders_paid_recorded.value:
"orders"."status" IN ('pending', 'failed')
        OR ("orders"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."provider_payment_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "orders"."charged_cents" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."charged_currency" IS NOT NULL)

orders_refund_recorded.name: orders_refund_recorded
orders_refund_recorded.value:
("orders"."status" = 'refunded') = ("orders"."refunded_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("orders"."status" IN ('refunding', 'refunded')) = ("orders"."refund_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("orders"."refund_reason" IS NULL) = ("orders"."refund_requested_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("orders"."refund_reason" = 'admin') = ("orders"."refund_listing_action" IS NOT NULL)

orders_outcome_after_payment.name: orders_outcome_after_payment
orders_outcome_after_payment.value:
("orders"."outcome" IS NULL) = ("orders"."applied_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("orders"."applied_at" IS NULL OR "orders"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL)
